entries.title: Proverbs 16:1
segments: ¶The preparations of the heart [belong] to man, But the answer of the tongue [is] from the LORD.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:2
segments: ¶All the ways of a man [are] pure in his own eyes, But the LORD weighs the spirits.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:3
segments: ¶Commit your works to the LORD, And your thoughts will be established.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:4
segments: ¶The LORD has made all for Himself, Yes, even the wicked for the day of doom.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:5
segments: ¶Everyone proud in heart [is] an abomination to the LORD; [Though they join] forces, none will go unpunished.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:6
segments: ¶In mercy and truth Atonement is provided for iniquity; And by the fear of the LORD [one] departs from evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:7
segments: ¶When a man's ways please the LORD, He makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:8
segments: ¶Better [is] a little with righteousness, Than vast revenues without justice.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:9
segments: ¶A man's heart plans his way, But the LORD directs his steps.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:10
segments: ¶Divination [is] on the lips of the king; His mouth must not transgress in judgment.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:11
segments: ¶Honest weights and scales [are] the LORD'S; All the weights in the bag [are] His work.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:12
segments: ¶[It is] an abomination for kings to commit wickedness, For a throne is established by righteousness.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:13
segments: ¶Righteous lips [are] the delight of kings, And they love him who speaks [what is] right.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:14
segments: ¶As messengers of death [is] the king's wrath, But a wise man will appease it.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:15
segments: In the light of the king's face [is] life, And his favor [is] like a cloud of the latter rain.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:16
segments: ¶How much better to get wisdom than gold! And to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:17
segments: ¶The highway of the upright [is] to depart from evil; He who keeps his way preserves his soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:18
segments: ¶Pride [goes] before destruction, And a haughty spirit before a fall.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:19
segments: ¶Better [to be] of a humble spirit with the lowly, Than to divide the spoil with the proud.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:20
segments: ¶He who heeds the word wisely will find good, And whoever trusts in the LORD, happy [is] he.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:21
segments: ¶The wise in heart will be called prudent, And sweetness of the lips increases learning.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:22
segments: ¶Understanding [is] a wellspring of life to him who has it. But the correction of fools [is] folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:23
segments: ¶The heart of the wise teaches his mouth, And adds learning to his lips.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:24
segments: ¶Pleasant words [are like] a honeycomb, Sweetness to the soul and health to the bones.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:25
segments: ¶There is a way [that seems] right to a man, But its end [is] the way of death.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:26
segments: ¶The person who labors, labors for himself, For his [hungry] mouth drives him [on].

entries.title: Proverbs 16:27
segments: ¶An ungodly man digs up evil, And [it is] on his lips like a burning fire.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:28
segments: A perverse man sows strife, And a whisperer separates the best of friends.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:29
segments: ¶A violent man entices his neighbor, And leads him in a way [that is] not good.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:30
segments: He winks his eye to devise perverse things; He purses his lips [and] brings about evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:31
segments: ¶The silver-haired head [is] a crown of glory, [If] it is found in the way of righteousness.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:32
segments: ¶[He who is] slow to anger [is] better than the mighty, And he who rules his spirit than he who takes a city.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:33
segments: ¶The lot is cast into the lap, But its every decision [is] from the LORD.
